subject: Genetics
title: GWAS and Disease Hunting
description: A quick win: understand GWAS and Disease Hunting.

hook.text: Compare the DNA of 10,000 diabetics to 10,000 healthy people. The differences reveal disease genes. That's GWAS.

buildup.text: Genome-wide association studies scan millions of DNA positions across thousands of people looking for patterns.

discovery.text: GWAS found thousands of genetic variants linked to diseases. Type 2 diabetes alone has 400+ associated variants.

twist.text: Most variants have tiny effects. No single gene explains obesity or depression. Complex traits have complex genetics.

climax.text: GWAS transformed genetics from single-gene thinking to polygenic models. Most traits involve hundreds of small nudges.

punchline.text: One gene rarely matters. Thousands of tiny effects do.

quiz.question: What does a GWAS study compare?
options: DNA of people with and without a condition
